LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) like_num FROM post_like GROUP BY post_id ) l ON p.post_id = l.post_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) favorite_num FROM post_favorite GROUP BY post_id ) f ON p.post_id = f.post_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT post_id, SUM(cnt) AS comment_num FROM ( SELECT post_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM post_comment GROUP BY post_id
UNION ALL
